disclosure.heading: DOST can listen
disclosure.copy: When you start a listening session, DOST captures audio from your microphone to understand the emotional texture of how you speak — your energy, pace, and tone.
disclosure.bullet1: Audio is processed entirely on your phone. It never leaves your device.
disclosure.bullet2: Recordings are never saved. Audio exists only in memory for a few seconds, then is discarded.
disclosure.bullet3: Only anonymous signals — like energy level and speaking pace — and emotional themes are stored.
disclosure.bullet4: You start and stop each session yourself. DOST never listens in the background.
disclosure.notice: Please note: anyone speaking near your phone during a session may be captured. Only start a session when you’re comfortable with who’s around you.

threeVoices.title: A pause with your voices
threeVoices.step1Body: When you notice an intense reaction, feeling triggered, or behaving in a way that doesn’t serve you — pause. Notice which part of you is speaking right now.
threeVoices.step1Prompt: Which voice is loudest in you right now?
threeVoices.step2Body: Recognise which part is activated, without criticising it. The Pained Persona may be carrying hurt or fear. The Shielding Manager may be reacting with defensiveness, control, or people-pleasing.
threeVoices.step3Body: Honour what the Pained Persona or Shielding Manager is experiencing. These reactions often come from a legitimate need or an older wound that deserves acknowledgment.
threeVoices.step4Heading: Shift to the True Individuated Self
threeVoices.step4Body: Consciously move into your True Individuated Self — the grounded, authentic part of you. A few slow breaths. Feel your feet. Your values and long-term wellbeing are here.
threeVoices.step4Prompt: What do I actually need right now?
threeVoices.step5Heading: Respond from the True Individuated Self
threeVoices.step5Body: From this centred place, choose a response rather than reacting from the dysregulation. The goal is not to erase the Pained Persona or the Shielding Manager — only to let the True Individuated Self lead.
threeVoices.pickVoiceHint: Pick the one that feels truest right now.
threeVoices.voices.pained.name: Pained Persona
threeVoices.voices.pained.gloss: The emotional, reactive part — where hurt, fear, and unmet needs live.
threeVoices.voices.shielding.name: Shielding Manager
threeVoices.voices.shielding.gloss: The defensive, controlling, or people-pleasing part that tries to keep you safe.
threeVoices.voices.individuated.name: True Individuated Self
threeVoices.voices.individuated.gloss: The wise, grounded self that can observe clearly and respond rather than react.
threeVoices.doneHeading: Nothing more to do — just notice what shifted.
threeVoices.doneBody: This isn’t about silencing any part of you. It’s letting the True Individuated Self take the lead, while the other parts are still held.
